name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.3 degrees south of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 14 times in 4 visits over 16 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 52 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 28 hours starting 2025-07-03, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.38 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
